company.shortDescription: ACV operates an online marketplace for dealer car auctions, connecting buyers and sellers of wholesale used vehicles.
company.description: ACV operates an online marketplace for dealer car auctions, connecting buyers and sellers of wholesale used vehicles. Its platform provides vehicle listings, inspections, bidding, pricing data, transportation, inventory management, and vehicle financing services. Dealers can buy and sell vehicles online while accessing vehicle condition reports and wholesale market information.
